objective: Land the locally validated Reach provider hardening with capability-scoped Decodo credentials, current Web Scraping API routing, SearXNG discovery, bounded budget handling, multi-provider corroboration, and deep retrieval enrichment.

rulesConsidered: Reach is provider-independent; retrieval providers are replaceable resources.
F00 remains the evidence verification authority.
Decodo credentials must be isolated by provider capability and never committed.
CORROBORATION must preserve multi-provider evidence provenance.
DEEP retrieval may enrich an already-discovered source without being suppressed by URL deduplication.

forensicFindings: The merged Reach provider fabric still read a legacy DECODO_BASIC_AUTH for both Decodo Fast Search and Web Scraping.
The current local integration uses separate Fast Search and Web Scraping credentials successfully.
Deep scrape enrichment could be lost when URL deduplication retained the initial search candidate.
Bounded CORROBORATION output could favor the first provider when source caps were applied.
The Web Scraping integration needed to align with the current v2 endpoint and avoid sending a none-valued headless field.
changes: Fast Search now reads DECODO_FAST_SEARCH_API_KEY only.
Web Scraping now reads DECODO_WEB_SCRAPING_API_KEY only.
Optional Basic/Bearer auth scheme overrides are provider-scoped.
Web Scraping defaults to https://scraper-api.decodo.com/v2/scrape and omits headless when disabled.
SearXNG timeout increased to 10 seconds; Decodo Fast Search to 12 seconds; Web Scraping to 15 seconds.
HTML scrape output is sanitized before downstream text extraction.
Router initializes a bounded 100-operation development allowance when a Decodo credential is configured and no explicit budget is supplied.
Deep retrieval replaces an existing same-URL search candidate with HTTP_SCRAPE evidence so enrichment is retained.
CORROBORATION source capping preserves representation from each successful provider when possible.
Added a unit test proving Fast Search and Web Scraping use separate credentials.
research: SearXNG search API and container deployment documentation
Decodo Fast Search API and Web Scraping API documentation
Existing ShortForge Reach contract, cache, budget, and provenance architecture

security.notes: No real credentials are committed. Provider credentials are read only from environment variables. CI remains the final repository security admission evidence.
